The implementation is complete and verified. Here's a summary of what I built:

## `/workspace/submission/gateway.py` (20.7 KB, stdlib only)

**Framing & charset** — whole-text ASCII printability/HTAB/CR/LF check, split at the first `CRLFCRLF`, rejection of bare CR/LF in the header section, 512 physical header lines / 128 logical fields caps, unfolding (`line break + leading WSP run` → one SP), orphan-continuation rejection, token-name headers with optional WSP before the colon, compact-name expansion, and singleton duplicate detection.

**Field validation** — Call-ID charset/length, CSeq digits + WSP + exact method with range check, Content-Length (leading zeros) equal to the ASCII body length, non-empty Content-Type preserved verbatim, Privacy restricted to `id`/`none` case-insensitively.

**Address grammar** — display-names as token runs or quoted strings (with escapes, data `< > , ;`), bracketed and bare URIs, WSP inside brackets, case-insensitive `;tag=` with token rules, PPI/RPID/PAI parameter-free, PAI list splitting outside quotes/brackets with 1–2 members requiring one sip + one tel.

**URI normalization** — case-insensitive schemes, `%HH` user escapes decoded once and only to permitted user characters, case-sensitive user, DNS host labels (1–63, alphanumeric edges, ≤253 chars, single trailing dot, no escapes), no ports/params/passwords/query/sips, `tel:+DIGITS` (1–15, first nonzero), reserved `sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid` honored only in From/To/request-URI.

**Boundary policy** — syntax before authentication before identity; local subject existence, From/PPI resolution to allowed + hosted identities with PPI-else-From-else-primary selection; peer listing, PAI presence, agreement of all PAI/From/PPI/RPID claims and peer domain authority; untrusted always rejected; `upstream` propagation from rejected sources with re-evaluation of each hop's wire.

**Canonical wire output** — exact header order/capitalization, From rewritten to the selected identity (anonymous when private), tags preserved, PAI emitted only when privacy is inactive or `trusted_out`, and the original body appended verbatim.

Validation: public check passes byte-exact; 6 hand-written suites (~250 targeted cases), a randomized fuzz round (no crashes, idempotent wire stability), and performance/memory runs at the documented bounds (≈0.2 s and 4 MB input, 0.7 s with 120 headers × 2000 jobs) all under the published rlimits.
